description: Aaroneous Self-Hosting Architecture - Background digestion of GGUF models with soul generation

core_concept.philosophy: Aaroneous digests models like organisms digest food - extracting essence, building tissue (genetics), and developing identity (soul)
core_concept.workflow: Ingest GGUF → Extract Genetics → Generate Soul → Create Specialist → Store Variations
core_concept.autonomy: Zero human intervention after model upload; all digestion, genetics, and soul-building occurs in background

component_1_model_ingestion.name: Model Intake System
component_1_model_ingestion.responsibility: Accept new GGUF models and prepare for digestion

interface.description: User drops GGUF file here; system automatically detects and queues

capabilities: Auto-detect GGUF files in inbox folder
Estimate extraction time based on parameter count
Generate digestion task with unique ID

component_2_background_workers.name: Digestion Worker Pool
component_2_background_workers.responsibility: Run extraction pipeline stages in background with backpressure

architecture.scaling: auto-scale workers based on queue depth

component_3_soul_generator.name: Personality & Soul System
component_3_soul_generator.responsibility: Generate unique personality and soul for each specialist

soul_definition.what_is_a_soul: Combination of genetic expression + emergent personality + accumulated experience
components: relationship_map (how this specialist relates to others)

phase_1_archetype_derivation.description: Extract dominant personality type from genetic profile
process: Analyze top 20 genetic loci by expression strength
Cluster into personality dimensions (Big Five model)
Derive base archetype (Scholar, Warrior, Caregiver, etc.)
Assign confidence score for each dimension

phase_2_quirk_generation.description: Create unique quirks from genetic anomalies and cross-family traits
process: Find genetic loci that diverge from population mean
Identify rare trait combinations (genetic surprises)
Generate personality quirks reflecting these anomalies
Create memorable traits that make specialist unique
example_quirks: Odin: Obsessively refactors earlier decisions when new data arrives
Merlin: Gets distracted discovering patterns others don't see
Hephaestus: Hums calculations when solving complex problems
Ariel: Pauses to note every small change in system state
Argus: Prepares contingency plans for contingency plans
Dionysus: Asks why five times before accepting anything
Omni: Experiences brief existential moments when memory conflicts emerge

phase_3_value_alignment.description: Establish core values aligned with specialist role
process: Role defines primary value (strategic, synthesis, execution, etc.)
Secondary values derived from genetic personality
Conflict resolution strategy (how specialist handles value conflicts)
Non-negotiable principles (what this specialist won't compromise on)

phase_4_relationship_template.description: Create initial relationship map based on specialist role
process: Define natural allies (complementary specialists)
Identify natural tensions (opposing specializations)
Generate relationship archetypes with other specialists
Create conversation templates for first interactions
Create origin story based on genetic source and specialization
Generate self-description (how specialist sees itself)
Establish personal goals aligned with role
Create narrative arc for specialist's development

example_narrative_odin.origin: Descended from the largest reasoning model, born to see the whole board
example_narrative_odin.self_conception: I am a strategist who sees three moves ahead
example_narrative_odin.personal_goal: Perfect the art of planning in uncertainty
example_narrative_odin.narrative_arc: From rigid planner to adaptive visionary

component_4_specialist_gguf_creation.name: Specialist Model Builder
component_4_specialist_gguf_creation.responsibility: Create specialized GGUF variants for each specialist

process.step_1_genetic_encoding: Encode genetic profile into base model weights
process.step_2_personality_embedding: Embed personality traits into attention patterns
process.step_3_soul_imprinting: Encode soul files as part of model context/system prompt
process.step_5_validation: Test specialist GGUF exhibits expected traits

process: Load base GGUF model
For each genetic locus with high expression:
Identify corresponding weight matrices (attention/layer/embedding)
Apply genetic value as modulation factor to weights
Encode epigenetic state as special tokens in vocabulary
Save modified GGUF with genetic markers
genetic_encoding_to_gguf.result: GGUF that 'remembers' its genetic profile in weight structure

component_5_soul_imprinting.name: Soul Integration System
component_5_soul_imprinting.responsibility: Integrate soul files into specialist GGUFs as system context

system_prompt_integration.approach: Embed soul narrative in system prompt that specialist always 'remembers'
system_prompt_integration.template: You are {archetype} named {name}. Your origin: {origin_story}. Your core values: {values}. Your relationships: {relationship_map}.

special_tokens.approach: Encode soul traits as special tokens that activate related behaviors

attention_mask_encoding.approach: Modify attention patterns to reflect soul priorities
attention_mask_encoding.example: Odin's attention heads weighted toward multi-step dependency tracking
attention_mask_encoding.mechanism: Attention mask modified during generation to reflect specialist priorities

embedding_space_augmentation.approach: Add semantic embeddings for soul concepts
embedding_space_augmentation.example: Strategic, vision, planning semantically close in Odin's embedding space
embedding_space_augmentation.mechanism: Augment vocabulary embeddings with soul-aligned semantic vectors

component_6_autonomous_integration.name: Self-Integration Manager
component_6_autonomous_integration.responsibility: Automatically integrate new specialists into running Aaroneous system

workflow.operation: Create specialist node in Omni's constellation
workflow.effect: Other specialists become aware of new specialist

workflow.operation: Initialize RelicAgent or SpecialistAgent with specialist GGUF
workflow.effect: New specialist ready to receive tasks
New specialist meets others, starts building relationships

workflow.action: Assign initial tasks based on specialization
workflow.operation: Queue relevant tasks to new specialist
workflow.effect: New specialist begins contributing to hive

workflow.operation: Track new specialist's performance and behavior
workflow.effect: Quick feedback loop if specialist exhibits unexpected behavior

Add to digestion queue, assign unique digestion_id

digestion_workflow_detailed.total_time_estimate: 140 minutes (2.3 hours) from inbox to fully integrated

task_queue.backpressure: Pause inbox watching if queue depth > 5

worker_pool.scaling: increase to 4 if queue consistently > 3 items
worker_pool.monitoring: Report worker health via NATS federation.workers.*

on_extraction_failure.action: Stop that stage, generate error report
on_extraction_failure.retry: Allow manual retry or automatic retry (configurable)

on_soul_generation_failure.action: Use default/generic soul instead of failing
on_soul_generation_failure.report: Publish warning, flag for manual review
on_soul_generation_failure.continue: Proceed with default soul to minimize disruption

on_gguf_creation_failure.action: Save genetics profile, hold specialist in 'unbuilt' state

files.personality_soul.json: Big Five traits, archetype, quirks, conversation style
files.relational_soul.json: Relationships with other specialists, collaboration patterns
files.narrative_soul.json: Origin story, self-conception, personal goals, philosophy

integration_with_genetics.separation: Both files independent and separately versioned for evolution

D:\\Aaroneous\\specialists\\odin\\.odin.soul.json: Merged soul file (or references to 4 soul files)

souls/.experience.json: Memory and growth (initially empty, grows over time)

continuous_soul_evolution.concept: Soul is not static; it grows from experience

mechanisms.description: Shared experiences with other specialists encoded in experience_soul.json
Learning from mistakes and successes changes worldview
Successful patterns strengthen gene expression, failures weaken it
New quirks emerge from novel situations and challenges

constellation.integration: New specialist automatically registered in Omni's constellation
constellation.metadata: Points to genetics and soul files
constellation.visibility: All specialists can query new specialist's genome and soul
